countries.reasoning: China is the largest producer of sulfuric acid globally, with extensive mining and chemical industries; data from USGS and industry reports 2023 confirm its dominance with stable output.
The US has substantial sulfuric acid production tied to its mining and refining sectors; USGS 2023 data provides reliable production figures.
India's industrial and fertilizer sectors drive sulfuric acid production, supported by national industry reports; data is well documented but slightly less comprehensive than China and US.
Russia is a major sulfuric acid producer, largely linked to its mining and petrochemical industries; data sources have moderately high reliability but with some reporting delays.
Japan maintains significant sulfuric acid production due to its chemical manufacturing sector; data is reliable but production is less than the top producers.
